leaves need a common verified support.
No line thickness is a beam dimension.
arch impost thrust, pier moments and
1800 court opening x5100–6900 is B only.
From stack centre x9685,y5050 to east.
Locate structural port before beam design;
do not core a selected beam afterwards.
Below door geography is not a free port.

arch/tie or roof reaction rebinds this grid.
